verses.text: After the Philistines captured the box of God, they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.
They carried the box of God into the temple of their god Dagon and set it beside Dagon's statue.
When the people of Ashdod got up early the next day, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground in front of the box of the LORD. They lifted Dagon up and put him back in his place.

But the next morning when they got up, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground again in front of the box of the LORD. His head and hands had been broken off and were lying in the doorway. Only his body was left.
That is why, to this day, the priests of Dagon and everyone who enters Dagon's temple in Ashdod do not step on the doorway.
The LORD's hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod and the villages around it. He brought disaster on them and struck them with painful swellings.
When the people of Ashdod saw what was happening, they said, "The box of the God of Israel must not stay here with us, because his hand is heavy on us and on our god Dagon."

So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and asked them, "What shall we do with the box of the God of Israel?" They answered, "Move the box of the God of Israel to Gath." So they moved the box of the God of Israel there.
But after they had moved it, the LORD's hand was against that city, throwing it into a great panic. He struck the people of the city, young and old, with an outbreak of swellings.
So they sent the box of God to Ekron. As it was coming into Ekron, the people of Ekron cried out, "They have brought the box of the God of Israel to us to kill us and our people!"

So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and said, "Send the box of the God of Israel away. Let it go back to its own place, or it will kill us and our people." Deadly panic had filled the city. God's hand was very heavy on it.
Those who did not die were struck with swellings, and the cry of the city went up to heaven.
